title: Shogun Showdown
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#490, 2026-10-14), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.16, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, D3DMetal, Metal HUD, DXVK async on, AVX advertised, recipes steam, controller-sdl, corefonts, dotnet48, vcrun2022, bloody-spell and xact, rated 4 of 5 after 3 minutes. The report had no app id; 2084000 is Steam's listing. Not verified by the maintainer. udance4ever (highball-db#774, 2026-10-29), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal, rated 5 of 5 after 2 minutes: the Epic copy, it starts and reacts to the controls, but a DualSense did not bind even with Sony button prompts selected.
notes: Playable on D3DMetal on the default engine. A DualSense is not picked up as a DirectInput pad despite the game's Sony glyph option; an XInput controller works.

knownIssues.symptom: No DualSense (DirectInput) support out of the box, an XInput controller works
knownIssues.fix: use an XInput controller, or Steam Input

knownIssues.symptom: DualSense controller not recognized by the game (an Xbox style XInput pad works)
knownIssues.fix: use an XInput pad, or start the game through Steam with Steam Input on (a non-Steam shortcut in the environment's Steam), as the reporter found with Breathedge
